title: 第6章封建大家长第7章相看
slug: 寒门医女别人练武我修仙
content_zh:
[境界：练气境&bp;11000]
[百草经注（大成）：尝百草&bp;3651000]
花长曦暂时没法弄到其他药材，《百草经注》下个篇章只能等着考入医药司后才能开启了。
她很期待，凡植、灵植之后会是什么？
至于修炼......
花长曦脑海中浮现出了梦里自己变成小鸟，如同小鸟一般呼吸的场景。
她知道，她的修炼应该是通过呼吸吐纳进行的。
想到这里，花长曦连忙尝试了一下，想看看白天能不能修炼，本想盘膝打坐的，可一想到小鸟是俯卧着的，便也趴在床上。
可惜，花长曦根本静不下心来，虽想象着小鸟呼吸的画面，可脑子里思绪乱飞，呼吸频率都是紊乱的，就更别说引动周围的气流入体了。
一下午，花长曦都在实验中，直到吃晚饭了也没成功。
......
傍晚时分，花家院子热闹了起来。
姚氏和两个妯娌都在厨房里忙活，花家上下二十多口人的饭食做起来不是件易事。
花老太太则带着几个孙女在堂屋外的屋檐下纺线和做女红。
花老爷子和下差回来的花明赫三兄弟坐在堂屋里抽旱烟，花三郎几个孙辈陪坐在一旁，在闲话外头发生的事。
花长曦从房间里出来，就受到了众人的关注。
花老太太手上纺线的动作不停，撩起眼皮看着花长曦：“身子好点了？”
花长曦笑着回道：“祖母，我已经没什么事了。”
花老太太在孙女们面前向来是不苟言笑的，淡淡的‘嗯’了一声，然后就开始说教：“有了这次的教训，看你以后还敢不敢乱跑。”
“家里的小娘子，就属你最不听话。”

“我就搞不懂了，都是花家的小娘子，五娘她们都能安安分分的呆在家里绣花织布，怎么你就非得往外跑？”
对于花老太太的念叨，花长曦早就已经习惯了，面色不变，直接左耳进右耳出。
“九娘，进来端菜。”
姚氏的声音从厨房里传出，把花长曦从花老太太的念叨中解救了出来。
......
花家二十多口人，吃饭分了两桌，大人一桌，孩子一桌。
吃饭前，花老爷子突然招手将花长曦叫到了身边，面色还算和蔼的问道：“你今天下午去药铺了？”
闻言，花长曦立马看向花三郎和花四郎。
花三郎神色有些惊讶，而花四郎则是没敢和花长曦对视。
花长曦顿时明白花老爷子为何会知道她去药铺了：“嗯，我去药铺抓了几副补气血的药回来。”
花老太太顿时拉长了脸：“你昨儿个才被绑架，今天就又敢溜出门了，你是真不长记性啊。”
“花九娘，你就作吧，把名声搞坏了，看你以后怎么嫁人！”
花老爷子由着花老太太说教了一阵，才继续开口：“九娘，你已经满十三了，是个大姑娘了，不好再继续在外抛头露面了。”
“日后，药铺那边你就不要去帮忙了。”
“你六哥、八哥现今已不上学了，是该让他们到药铺里历练历练了，你就在家和姐妹们一起绣花织布吧。”
听到这话，花家众人的神色都有些波动。
对于花长曦能到药铺里帮忙，二房和四房其实都是有些不满的。
一来，都是花家的小娘子，花长曦能去药铺学医术，而其他小娘子却要在家里学女红织布，自然会让二房、四房的人觉得不公。
再来就是，花长曦表现出的医书天赋，让二房、四房有些忌惮，生怕她抢占了自家儿子的资源。
花老爷子的话，说得很平缓温和，却带着不容拒绝。

花明赫有些欲言又止，可看着二弟两口子和四弟两口子都一副认同的模样，到底没为自家女儿说话。
家里的资源，大房占得最多。
content_en:
[Realm: Qi training realm&bp;11000]
[Notes on Baicao Jing (Dacheng): Taste Baicao&bp;3651000]
Hua Changxi was unable to obtain other medicinal materials for the time being, so the next chapter of "Annotations to the Baicao Jing" could only be opened after she was admitted to the Department of Medicine.
She is looking forward to what will happen next to Fanzhi and Lingzhi?
As for practicing...
Hua Changxi's mind recalled the scene in her dream where she turned into a bird and breathed like a bird.
She knew that her practice should be carried out through breathing.
Thinking of this, Hua Changxi quickly tried it to see if she could practice during the day. She originally wanted to sit cross-legged and meditate, but when she thought that the bird was prone, she also lay on the bed.
Unfortunately, Hua Changxi couldn't calm down at all. Although she imagined the scene of a bird breathing, her mind was racing with thoughts and her breathing rate was disordered, let alone inducing the surrounding air to flow into her body.
Hua Changxi was experimenting all afternoon until dinner, but with no success.
...
In the evening, Hua's courtyard became lively.
Yao and her two sisters-in-law were busy in the kitchen. It was not easy to prepare meals for more than 20 members of the Hua family.
Mrs. Hua took several of her granddaughters to spin yarn and make needlework under the eaves outside the hall.
Mr. Hua and the three brothers Hua Minghe who had returned from a business trip were sitting in the main room smoking cigarettes. Hua Sanlang and several grandchildren were sitting beside them, chatting about what happened outside.
Hua Changxi came out of the room and attracted everyone's attention.
Mrs. Hua kept spinning in her hands and looked at Hua Changxi with her eyelids raised: "Are you feeling better?"
Hua Changxi smiled and replied: "Grandma, I have nothing to do."
Mrs. Hua was always serious in front of her granddaughters. She gave a faint 'hmm' and then began to lecture: "After this lesson, let's see if you dare to run around in the future."
"You, the little lady in the family, are the most disobedient."
"I just don't understand. They are all young ladies from the Hua family. The five ladies can stay at home peacefully, embroidering and weaving. Why do you have to run out?"
Hua Changxi had long been used to Mrs. Hua's nagging. Her expression remained unchanged and she went straight in and out of one ear.
"Jiuniang, come in and serve the food."
Yao's voice came from the kitchen, saving Hua Changxi from Mrs. Hua's mumbling.
...
There are more than 20 people in the Hua family, and they are divided into two tables for meals, one for adults and one for children.
Before eating, Mr. Hua suddenly waved Hua Changxi to his side and asked with a kind face, "Did you go to the drug store this afternoon?"
Hearing this, Hua Changxi immediately looked at Huasaburo and Huashiro.
Huasaburo looked a little surprised, while Huasilang did not dare to look at Hua Changxi.
Hua Changxi immediately understood why Mr. Hua knew that she had gone to the drug store: "Well, I went to the drug store to grab some medicine to replenish qi and blood."
Mrs. Hua suddenly had a long face: "You were kidnapped yesterday, and you dared to sneak out again today. You really don't have a long memory."
"Hua Jiuniang, just do it and ruin your reputation. Let's see how you get married in the future!"
Mr. Hua let Mrs. Hua preach for a while before he continued: "Jiuniang, you are already thirteen and a big girl. It is not good for you to continue to show your face outside."
"In the future, you won't be able to help at the drug store."
"Your sixth brother and eighth brother are no longer in school. It's time for them to go to the medicine shop to practice. You can embroider and weave at home with your sisters."
Hearing this, the expressions of everyone in the Hua family fluctuated.
The second and fourth bedrooms were actually a little dissatisfied with Hua Changxi being able to help in the pharmacy.
First of all, they are all young ladies from the Hua family. Hua Changxi can go to the drug store to learn medical skills, while other young ladies have to learn female red weaving at home. Naturally, the people in the second and fourth bedrooms feel it is unfair.
Next, Hua Changxi expressedThe displayed talent in medical books made the second and fourth families a little wary, fearing that she would seize their son's resources.
Mr. Hua's words were spoken very calmly and gently, but with a tone that could not be rejected.
Hua Minghe was hesitant to speak, but seeing that his second brother and his fourth brother both seemed to agree, they did not speak for his daughter.
The big house occupies the most resources at home.
